title: Island of the Dolls

slides.text: HE HUNG DOLLS FOR 50 YEARS TO KEEP A SPIRIT HAPPY
Xochimilco, Mexico City. A maze of old canals and tiny floating gardens.
On one small island lived a man named Don Julián Santana. Alone, for decades.
He said a young girl drowned in the canal by his island... and soon after, he found a doll floating in the water.
He hung it in a tree to honor her. Then he hung another. And another.
For about 50 years he collected dolls from the trash and the canals. Hundreds of them. On trees, fences and walls.
In 2001, Don Julián was found drowned. Reports say it was in the same canal where he said the girl died.
No record of the girl has ever been found. But his family kept the island... and the dolls.
Today you can take a boat there. The dolls are still hanging, rotting in the sun and rain.
